data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (origin/destination, trip type, dates, points option, search, Sort & Filter with Price by Core, Apply), but it fixes the sort as price instead of a sort_option parameter and models payment as a boolean use_points, so it is somewhat less general; it is still concrete enough to automate.
